name: io.github.zyno-io/zynohosting
title: ZynoHosting
description: Manage ZynoHosting sites and create, discover, embed, and configure ZynoForms through local stdio.

environmentVariables.description: Absolute local roots the MCP server may read and write, separated by the platform path delimiter.
environmentVariables.name: ZYNO_HOSTING_MCP_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Optional tenant API key. Omit it when using credentials saved by zynohosting login.
environmentVariables.name: ZYNO_HOSTING_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional ZynoSuite API URL override for form tools. Standard production, alpha, and dev environments are inferred automatically.
environmentVariables.name: ZYNO_SUITE_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional Zyno Auth API URL override for scoped-token renewal. Standard production, alpha, and dev environments are inferred automatically.
environmentVariables.name: ZYNO_AUTH_API_URL
